contents.reason: Owner scope decision (2026-10-05): out of scope with no destination. Current FR-19 claims the Euclidean full-rank lattice Poisson formula, two-sided-decay extension, and sampling results; no planned item consumes the general closed-subgroup LCA formula. Adding that theorem and its compatible-Haar proof would materially rebuild FR-19. The current Euclidean lattice claims remain in scope.

contents.name: Lemma 13.1: the sets {x : |⟨x,χ⟩-⟨x1,χ⟩| < ε for all χ ∈ K}, K compact in Ĝ, are open and form neighbourhood bases at each x1 ∈ G (statement only; no proof in this source)
Lemma 13.2: compactly supported nonnegative transform bumps around each point of the dual (statement only; no proof in this source)
Theorem 13.3: Pontryagin's duality theorem, Φ an algebraic isomorphism and homeomorphism (statement only; no proof in this source)
Lemma 13.4: consequences of duality for measures, inverse transforms and units of L^1(G)
contents.reason: The measure/uniqueness content is FR-16's and the unit criterion is FR-16 item 1e; nothing on this page needs 13.4.

contents.name: Definition 14.1 and Lemma 14.2: the annihilator H^⊥, closedness, H^⊥⊥=H, (G/H)^≅H^⊥ and Ĝ/H^⊥≅Ĥ (statements only)
Theorem 14.3: every character of a closed subgroup extends (statement only)
Lemma 14.4: duals of finite direct sums; Exercise 14.5: duals of products of compact groups

Theorem 14.6 (principal structure theorem) and Lemmas 14.7-14.14 (dense cyclic groups, Z^n cocompact subgroups, compact open sets, totally disconnected groups, locally Euclidean connected groups, compact sections of open maps, and the two-step reduction) (statements only; no proofs in this source)
Theorem 15.1 and the final remarks: the alternative Hewitt-Ross route via compactly generated groups
contents.reason: Orientation for a different proof order (duality for compact and discrete groups first); not used by this page's rows.
